nodes.label: Canvas generative plants hero
nodes.rationale: Recursive branch() drawing on canvas grows plants procedurally in the hero, tying the visual to the nursery theme.

nodes.label: core.css shared shell (inlined by _kit/build.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Shared CSS shell for generated Signature templates: semantic :root theme tokens overridden per recipe, reduced-motion safety net, anim-ok/no-anim opt-in classes, and reusable section patterns (hero variants, zigzag, bento, gallery, pricing, faq, contact form). Inlined into each template by _kit/build.mjs so there is no runtime dependency.
